question: In which race did the fastest 1st lap time was recorded? Please indicate the time in milliseconds.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T2.name, T1.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes AS T1
JOIN RaceDetails AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T1.lap = 1
ORDER BY T1.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1
